name: Assault Mastery
summary: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: The Great Wolf Watches
summary: Once per battle round per unit, an Adeptus Astartes Infantry Character unit can be targeted by Heroic Intervention regardless of other uses that phase, without blocking other units from using it too. Army: Space Wolves only.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability gain: Furor Tactics — while the devastator doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; Malleus Tactics — while the tactical doctrine is active, [LETHAL HITS]; Purgatus Tactics — while the assault doctrine is active, attacks targeting an enemy unit within 9" of the unit have [PRECISION]. DEATHWATCH units may be included regardless of Chapter faction keyword, combined points not exceeding 500. Unless stated otherwise, a DEATHWATCH model cannot be WARLORD. KILL TEAM units take enhancements only from this detachment.

name: Devastator Mastery
summary: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Combined Deployment
summary: In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

name: Codex Discipline
summary: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Walking Fortress
summary: In a turn in which a friendly Gravis unit has made a Normal move, that unit's ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Defence
summary: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls.

name: Enduring Vengeance
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, excluding Walker units, can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll for their ranged attacks.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: When a friendly Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot, choose one effect: those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden; or that unit can make a normal move of up to D6", and it is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

name: Legendary Slayers
summary: Adeptus Astartes attacks on Character, Monster or Vehicle units have Lethal Hits; once you have destroyed half the enemy's such units (rounding up), your Saga completes and all your attacks have Lethal Hits.

name: Howling Onslaught
summary: Once per battle, if Logan Grimnar is on the battlefield, you can re-select an already-used Hunting Pack when choosing one for the Master of Wolves ability.

name: Master of Wolves
summary: Each Command phase, pick one Hunting Pack for Adeptus Astartes units until your next Command phase: re-roll Advance/Charge, +1 to ranged Hit rolls, or Lethal Hits/Sustained Hits 1 in the Fight phase (once per battle each).

name: Restrictions
summary: Your army can include Space Wolves units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
summary: While this rule is active, friendly units with the Adeptus Astartes keyword that also have the Mounted or Speeder keyword add 2" to their Move characteristic.

name: Tactical Mastery
summary: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
summary: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
summary: Friendly Tacticus units' [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when they target units at any distance up to that attack's maximum range.

name: Death Blow
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units add 1 to their charge rolls.
